name: Web Alchemy Product Slug Transliteration
author: webalchemy

sections.description:
Keep new product URLs readable with Latin characters. Enable automatic transliteration in Settings > Slug Transliteration, or use the text preview before creating a product.

  • Ukrainian and Russian character mapping, including URL-encoded text.
  • Automatic processing of new products, including the first save of an auto-draft.
  • Existing product URLs and custom Latin slugs stay unchanged.
  • Disabled by default; no mass changes on activation.
  • No usage quota, expiry, account, key, telemetry or remote requests.

WooCommerce is required for automatic product processing. The text preview does not change products. WordPress resolves published URL conflicts during saving. This plugin does not create redirects or promise search rankings.

The separate commercial WA Slug Transliteration plugin offers catalog-wide preview, batch processing and recovery. Premium code is not included in this Free package. The optional product link appears only on this plugin’s settings screen; following it is not required for Free functionality.

No third-party libraries, fonts or media are bundled.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload this plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New, then activate it.
  3. Open Settings > Slug Transliteration and enable new-product processing if needed.
sections.faq:
Does this change existing links?

No. Existing products are left unchanged, including when their title is edited.

Do I need a paid key?

No. All functionality in this package works without a key or external service.

Is any data sent to Web Alchemy?

No. The plugin does not make external requests. Its optional Pro link opens the public product website only when clicked.

Can I keep the existing paid plugin?

Yes. This Free plugin has distinct function/class names and settings. Existing paid licenses are not migrated or replaced. Both can be installed; a Latin slug produced by one is left unchanged by the other.
